overview_description.description:
Atelier KorkmazChef is Dubai’s first multi-brand gastronomy factory, designed by chefs for chefs. Operating a 500 m² glass-walled production facility, we produce daily fresh, premium, innovative products under four brands: 

- Gildleaf: Luxury baklava & pistachio caviar
- Sue Tiramisu: Modern tiramisu collections
- Jarji: Authentic mezze, pickles & sauces
- Prisma: Gel-form cocktail innovations

Our B2B model supplies luxury hotels, restaurants, catering groups, and airlines, solving high operating costs, chef shortages, and fresh supply challenges in the UAE’s premium F&B market. We do not sell directly to consumers; all products are delivered through our partner businesses. 

We are seeking early equity investors to partner in scaling Dubai’s first multi-brand gastronomy hub, bringing fresh, innovative, and exclusive culinary creations to the region. The founder, Abdullah Korkmaz, manages operations, setup, and sales from A to Z, holding 20% equity, with investors taking 80%.
